parameters.query: SELECT $1::text AS file, cc.etag AS cached_etag, cc.body AS cached_body FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy LEFT JOIN config_cache cc ON cc.file = $1

INSERT INTO config_cache (file, etag, body, fetched_at, last_good_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (file) DO UPDATE SET etag = EXCLUDED.etag, body = EXCLUDED.body, fetched_at = now(), last_good_at = now() RETURNING file
